series.name: APC Easy UPS SRV / SRVL (Modbus Fault-code ENUM, register 44497 / 0x1190)
series.notes: This is the SRV/SRVL *register* fault list, not the LCD text codes. Codes are 8-bit hex values read from holding register 44497 (0x1190). Family groupings published by SE are: Bus fault, Inverter fault, Electric link fault, Parallel system fault, Others. This table is distinct from the Easy UPS SRV LCD/event-log short codes (CH9, BDC, DCF, DCH, OUF, SC, BOU, HOT, OL, INF, EEF) which are documented separately - see NEGATIVE/CONFLICTS. Three-phase-only values (0x15/0x16/0x1B/0x1C) are meaningless on a 1-phase SRV unit.

meaning.en: The register is reading clear: the UPS has no active fault.
meaning.ur: Register saaf parh raha hai: UPS par koi active fault nahi hai.

causes.en: Normal operation, no fault latched.
causes.ur: Normal chal raha hai, koi fault latch nahi hua.

solutions.en: No action needed; this is the healthy baseline value.
solutions.ur: Koi karakari zaroori nahi; yeh sehat baseline value hai.

solutions.en: Use it as the reference when reading a fault: compare against this value after every battery or firmware change.
solutions.ur: Isay reference banayein: battery ya firmware ki har tabdeeli ke baad is value se compare karein.

notes.en: Included so the app can render a positive 'no fault' reading instead of an empty state.
notes.ur: Is liye shamil kiya ke app khali state ke bajaye 'no fault' ka positive reading dikhaye.

source.title: Easy UPS SRV/SRVL Modbus Register Map (Network Management Card)

meaning.en: The card received a fault value it has no description for, so the UPS reports an unidentified error.
meaning.ur: Card ko aisi fault value mili hai jiska usay pata nahi, is liye UPS anjaan error report karta hai.

causes.en: Card firmware older than the UPS firmware, so a newer fault value is unrecognised.
causes.ur: Card ka firmware UPS firmware se purana hai, is liye nayi fault value pehchani nahi ja rahi.

causes.en: Communication corruption between card and UPS, so the register read a garbage value.
causes.ur: Card aur UPS ke darmiyan communication corrupt ho gaya, is liye register ne garbage value parha.

solutions.en: Re-read the register a second time; a stable 0xFF across several reads is a real unknown fault, not noise.
solutions.ur: Register dobara parhein; kai readings par same 0xFF aaye to woh asli unknown fault hai, noise nahi.

solutions.en: Check the card and UPS firmware versions and update the card to match the UPS.
solutions.ur: Card aur UPS ke firmware versions check karein aur card ko UPS ke mutabiq update karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the card and the UPS, then read the register again before escalating.
solutions.ur: Card aur UPS ko power-cycle karein, phir report karne se pehle register dobara parhein.

solutions.en: If 0xFF persists with matching firmware, record the other status words and escalate with them attached.
solutions.ur: Agar firmware match karne par bhi 0xFF qarar rahe to baaki status words note karein aur unke saath escalate karein.

notes.en: SE's own wording is 'NO: Unknown Error' - it is a placeholder, not a diagnosis.
notes.ur: SE ka apna alfaz hai 'NO: Unknown Error' - yeh placeholder hai, diagnosis nahi.

meaning.en: The DC bus did not build up to the required voltage when the rectifier was started.
meaning.ur: Rectifier start hone par DC bus ki voltage required level tak nahi pohanchi.

causes.en: Battery string disconnected or dead, so the bus cannot charge.
causes.ur: Battery string disconnect ya kharab hai, is liye bus charge nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Rectifier soft-start circuit failed, so the charging path never opens fully.
causes.ur: Rectifier soft-start circuit kharab hai, is liye charging path poori tarah khulti hi nahi.

causes.en: Pre-charge relay or bus capacitor failed open.
causes.ur: Pre-charge relay ya bus capacitor khul kar kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and the battery, then measure the DC bus with a meter to confirm it is dead and not merely unlogged.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir DC bus ko meter se nikaalein taake confirm ho ke bus margi hai, sirf log nahi hua.

solutions.en: Check the battery string voltage and each cell; recharge for at least 4 hours and retry the start.
solutions.ur: Battery string voltage aur har cell check karein; kam az kam 4 ghante charge karein aur dobara start karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the pre-charge relay contacts for welding and confirm the bus capacitors are not shorted to earth.
solutions.ur: Pre-charge relay ke contacts par welding check karein aur confirm karein ke bus capacitors earth par short nahi hain.

solutions.en: If the bus is healthy but will not start, the rectifier drive board has failed and must be serviced.
solutions.ur: Agar bus sehat hai magar start nahi hota to rectifier drive board kharab hai aur service zaroori hai.

notes.en: Distinguish this from 0x03 (Bus volt under): 0x01 is a failure to *start*, 0x03 is a drop *after* start.
notes.ur: Isay 0x03 (Bus volt under) se alag rakhein: 0x01 start karne ki kharabi hai, 0x03 start ke baad girne ki.

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage has exceeded the over-voltage threshold, so the UPS shut the rectifier down to protect the capacitors.
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage over-voltage threshold se upar chala gaya hai, is liye UPS ne capacitors bachane ke liye rectifier band kar diya.

causes.en: AC input voltage far too high, so the rectifier over-charges the bus.
causes.ur: AC input voltage bohat zyada hai, is liye rectifier bus ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

causes.en: Battery disconnected or a branch open, so charging current has nowhere to go.
causes.ur: Battery disconnect ya koi branch khuli hai, is liye charging current ka koi rasta nahi.

causes.en: Rectifier voltage-sense divider failed, so the control loop sees a low bus and keeps driving it up.
causes.ur: Rectifier ka voltage-sense divider kharab hai, is liye control loop bus ko kam parh kar upar chalata rehta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the input voltage with a multimeter and confirm it is within the unit's rated input window.
solutions.ur: Input voltage multimeter se nikaalein aur confirm karein ke yeh unit ki rated window ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery is actually connected and the string fuse is intact; an open battery branch causes exactly this.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke battery waqai connect hai aur string fuse salamat hai; battery branch khuli hone se yahi hota hai.

solutions.en: Measure each battery cell's voltage; cells sitting well above float voltage confirm over-charge rather than a sense fault.
solutions.ur: Har battery cell ka voltage nikaalein; float voltage se bohat upar hone par over-charge confirm hota hai, sense fault nahi.

solutions.en: If cells are normal and input is normal, the rectifier voltage-sense divider is faulty and needs component-level service.
solutions.ur: Agar cells aur input normal hon to rectifier voltage-sense divider kharab hai aur component level par service chahiye.

notes.en: Over-voltage on the bus stresses capacitors and batteries - do not leave the unit running on battery indefinitely to 'get through' it.
notes.ur: Bus par over-voltage capacitors aur batteries par zulm hai - unit ko battery par chala kar 'guar' na karein.

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage has dropped below the under-voltage threshold, so the inverter cannot keep the output regulated.
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage under-voltage threshold se neeche gir gaya hai, is liye inverter output regulate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Battery string aged, deep-discharged or fully flat.
causes.ur: Battery string purani, deep-discharge ho chuki ya poori tarah flat hai.

causes.en: Battery fuse blown or a cell open, dropping the bus below the inverter's needs.
causes.ur: Battery fuse uth gaya ya koi cell khul gaya, bus inverter ki zaroorat se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: Prolonged overload drained the bus faster than the rectifier could recover it.
causes.ur: Lamba overload bus ko rectifier ke recover karne se zyada tez drain kar gaya.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, then measure the string and each cell with a DC meter.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein, battery disconnect karein, phir string aur har cell ko DC meter se nikaalein.

solutions.en: If the pack is merely discharged, charge on mains for at least 4 hours and re-read this register before suspecting hardware.
solutions.ur: Agar pack sirf discharge hui hai to mains par kam az kam 4 ghante charge karein aur hardware ka shak karna se pehle yeh register dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Check the battery string fuse continuity with an ohmmeter; replace with the same rating if open.
solutions.ur: Battery string fuse ki continuity ohmmeter se check karein; khuli ho to usi rating se badal dein.

solutions.en: Look for a cell that reads far below its neighbours - that cell is the open circuit and should be replaced, not the whole UPS.
solutions.ur: Aisi cell dhundein jo padosi se bohat neeche parh rahi ho - wohi khuli circuit hai aur usay badal dein, poora UPS nahi.

notes.en: Often the downstream symptom of 0x43 (Overload fault) - fix the load first, then re-read this register.
notes.ur: Aam tor par yeh 0x43 (Overload fault) ka neeche ka nateeja hai - pehle load theek karein, phir yeh register dobara parhein.

meaning.en: Voltage on the two halves of the DC bus is not equal, so the inverter output is unbalanced and the unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: DC bus ke do halves ka voltage barabar nahi hai, is liye inverter output unbalanced hai aur unit band ho jata hai.

causes.en: One bus capacitor failed short or open, so its half bus sags.
causes.ur: Bus ka aik capacitor short ya khul ho kar kharab hua, uska half bus gir gaya.

causes.en: A rectifier leg or SCR failing, so it contributes less charge to its half.
causes.ur: Rectifier ka aik leg ya SCR kharab ho kar us half mein kam charge de raha hai.

causes.en: Voltage-divider sensing fault on one half making the control loop over/under-correct that side.
causes.ur: Aik half par voltage-divider sensing fault, is liye control loop us taraf zyada/ya kam correction karta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the two bus halves separately with a DC voltmeter and compare the difference.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir DC voltmeter se bus ke do halves ko alag alag nikaal kar farq compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure each bus capacitor's capacitance and ESR; a drifted ESR on one half causes imbalance with no visible damage.
solutions.ur: Har bus capacitor ki capacitance aur ESR nikaalein; aik half par drifted ESR baghair nazar dast ke bina farq paida karta hai.

solutions.en: Compare the two halves of the battery string too; an imbalanced battery string mirrors a bus imbalance.
solutions.ur: Battery string ke do halves bhi compare karein; unbalanced battery string bus imbalance ki shakal ban jati hai.

solutions.en: If halves measure equal but the code persists, the balance sensing divider is faulty and needs board-level service.
solutions.ur: Agar halves barabar parhein magar code qarar rahe to balance sensing divider kharab hai aur board level par service chahiye.

notes.en: Bus imbalance destroys inverter IGBTs quickly if left running - treat as stop-production.
notes.ur: Bus imbalance chalta rehne par inverter IGBTs jaldi kharab kar deta hai - production-stop samajhein.

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected across the DC bus, so the UPS has locked out to prevent a very high fault current.
meaning.ur: DC bus ke aacross short circuit detect hua hai, is liye UPS ne bohat high fault current rokne ke liye lock out kar diya.

causes.en: Bus capacitor failed shorted, which is the most common cause.
causes.ur: Bus capacitor short ho kar kharab hua hai - yeh sab se aam wajah hai.

causes.en: External battery cabinet connected with reversed polarity or a damaged cable pinching a cell.
causes.ur: External battery cabinet ulat polarity ke saath laga hai ya damaged cable kisi cell ko nichal rahi hai.

causes.en: SCR or rectifier leg failed shorted, dumping current into the bus.
causes.ur: SCR ya rectifier leg short ho kar kharab, bus mein current daal raha hai.

solutions.en: Do not re-power the unit. Isolate mains and disconnect the battery first.
solutions.ur: Unit dobara power na karein. Pehle mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure resistance across the DC bus with the battery disconnected; a very low ohms reading confirms the short.
solutions.ur: Battery disconnect kar ke DC bus ke aacross resistance nikaalein; bohat kam ohms reading short confirm karti hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect bus capacitors one at a time and re-measure to identify which capacitor has failed shorted.
solutions.ur: Bus capacitors ek-ek karke nikaal kar dobara measure karein taake pata chale kaunsa capacitor short hua hai.

solutions.en: Verify the external battery cabinet's polarity and cable pinching before reconnection, and never connect a cabinet blind.
solutions.ur: Reconnect karne se pehle external battery cabinet ki polarity aur cable pinching check karein, aur kabhi andaza kar ke connect na karein.

notes.en: This is the most dangerous code in the family: a live bus short can melt tooling and start a fire.
notes.ur: Yeh family ka sab se khatarnaq code hai: bus ka live short tools pighal kar aag laga sakta hai.

meaning.en: The rectifier/converter stage drew more current than its limit, so the unit has shut that stage down.
meaning.ur: Rectifier/converter stage ne apni limit se zyada current kheecha, is liye unit ne wo stage band kar diya.

causes.en: Battery string deeply discharged or shorted, so the converter tries to push huge charge current.
causes.ur: Battery string deep-discharge ya short ho kar, is liye converter bohat zyada charge current dene ki koshish karta hai.

causes.en: Input voltage far above or below the converter's operating window, forcing the stage out of its efficient region.
causes.ur: Input voltage converter ki window se bahar hai, is liye stage apne efficient area se bahar chala jata hai.

causes.en: Input filter capacitor degraded so ripple current rises and trips the converter over-current limit.
causes.ur: Input filter capacitor weak ho gaya is liye ripple current barh kar converter over-current limit par trip kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure battery string resistance; a low reading points to a shorted cell causing the over-current.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir battery string ki resistance nikaalein; kam reading shorted cell ki taraf ishara karti hai.

solutions.en: Check input voltage quality with a meter, and inspect the input filter capacitors for bulging, discoloration or leakage.
solutions.ur: Meter se input voltage ki quality check karein, aur input filter capacitors ko phoolay, rang badle ya leaking dekhein.

solutions.en: Confirm the input breaker and the input reactor are not saturating; a loose input connection causes current spikes.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke input breaker aur input reactor saturate nahi ho rahe; input connection loose hone se current spikes aate hain.

solutions.en: Replace a confirmed shorted cell or failed input filter capacitor rather than replacing the converter assembly blind.
solutions.ur: Confirm shorted cell ya kharab input filter capacitor badal dein, converter assembly andaza kar na badlein.

notes.en: Converter over-current is usually a symptom downstream of a battery or input problem, not a converter failure.
notes.ur: Converter over-current aam tor par battery ya input ki masla ka nateeja hai, converter ki kharabi nahi.

meaning.en: The inverter failed its soft-start routine and could not ramp up to a safe operating amplitude.
meaning.ur: Inverter apna soft-start routine poori tarah nahi adha kar saka aur safe amplitude tak nahi pohanch saka.

causes.en: Inverter IGBT or module failed open, so no current is being pushed into the transformer.
causes.ur: Inverter IGBT ya module khul ho kar kharab, is liye transformer mein koi current nahi ja raha.

causes.en: Inverter drive/gate-drive board failed, so the IGBTs are never commanded on.
causes.ur: Inverter gate-drive board kharab, is liye IGBTs ko kabhi on command nahi milta.

causes.en: DC bus voltage too low at start (see 0x03), so the inverter cannot build amplitude.
causes.ur: Start par DC bus voltage bohat kam hai (0x03 dekhein), is liye inverter amplitude nahi bana sakta.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the DC bus voltage to rule out a bus under-voltage before touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir inverter chhoone se pehle bus under-voltage rokne ke liye DC bus voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery string: if it is flat, charge on mains and retry before condemning the inverter.
solutions.ur: Battery string nikaalein: agar flat hai to mains par charge karke dobara try karein, inverter kharab kehne se pehle.

solutions.en: Check the inverter gate-drive board's supply rails and its fault output with a meter.
solutions.ur: Inverter gate-drive board ki supply rails aur uska fault output meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Have the inverter IGBTs tested at component level; a failed module means module replacement, not battery replacement.
solutions.ur: Inverter IGBT component level par test karwa lein; module kharab ho to module badalna hai, battery nahi.

notes.en: Distinguish from 0x13 (Inverter volt low) which is a running under-voltage, not a start failure.
notes.ur: Isay 0x13 (Inverter volt low) se alag rakhein jo chalte hue under-voltage hai, start ki kharabi nahi.

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage has exceeded its ceiling, so the unit has shut down to protect the load and the stage.
meaning.ur: Inverter output voltage apni ceiling se upar chala gaya hai, is liye unit ne load aur stage bachane ke liye band ho jata hai.

causes.en: DC bus over-voltage feeding the inverter (see 0x02), so the output reference is driven high.
causes.ur: Inverter ko zyada DC bus voltage mil rahi hai (0x02 dekhein), is liye output reference upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Inverter output voltage feedback sensor failed high, so the control loop keeps driving up.
causes.ur: Inverter output voltage feedback sensor high par kharab ho gaya, is liye control loop upar chalata rehta hai.

causes.en: Output neutral disconnected, so the inverter cannot regulate the line-to-neutral voltage correctly.
causes.ur: Output neutral disconnect ho gaya, is liye inverter line-to-neutral voltage theek se regulate nahi kar sakta.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure output voltage at each outlet with a meter to see which phase or line is high.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir har outlet par meter se output voltage nikaalein taake kaonsi phase ya line high hai pata chale.

solutions.en: Confirm the output neutral terminal is tight and connected; a loose neutral makes the output look unstable.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke output neutral terminal kassaa hua aur connected hai; loose neutral output ko unstable dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Read the DC bus voltage at the same time; if the bus is high, fix 0x02 first.
solutions.ur: Saath hi DC bus voltage parhein; agar bus high hai to pehle 0x02 hal karein.

solutions.en: If the bus is normal but the output is high, the inverter feedback divider is faulty and needs board-level service.
solutions.ur: Agar bus normal hai magar output high hai to inverter feedback divider kharab hai aur board level par service chahiye.

notes.en: High inverter output voltage can fry downstream equipment - keep the load disconnected while chasing this.
notes.ur: Inverter output voltage zyada hone se aage ka equipment kharab ho sakta hai - is masle par load disconnect hi rakhein.

source.title: Easy UPS SRV/SRVL Modbus Register Map (Network Management Card)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage has fallen below its floor while running, so the load is being under-supplied.
meaning.ur: Inverter output voltage chalte hue apni floor se neeche gir gaya hai, is liye load ko kam power mil rahi hai.

causes.en: Battery string exhausted, so the inverter cannot hold the output amplitude on discharge.
causes.ur: Battery string khatam ho gayi hai, is liye inverter discharge par output amplitude nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: Overload on the output pulling the bus down below what the inverter needs.
causes.ur: Output par overload bus ko inverter ki zaroorat se neeche kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Inverter output feedback sensor failed low, so the control loop keeps the output down.
causes.ur: Inverter output voltage feedback sensor low par kharab, is liye control loop output neeche rakhta hai.

causes.en: One inverter leg (IGBT) degraded, so that phase's output sags relative to the others.
causes.ur: Inverter ka aik leg (IGBT) weak hua hai, is liye us phase ka output doosron ke mutabiq gir jata hai.

solutions.en: Measure output voltage per phase with a meter and compare the phases; one low phase identifies a failed leg.
solutions.ur: Meter se har phase ka output voltage nikaal kar phases compare karein; aik kam phase kharab leg identify kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery string voltage and recharge on mains for at least 4 hours, then re-read the register.
solutions.ur: Battery string voltage nikaalein aur mains par kam az kam 4 ghante charge karke register dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Calculate the load against rated kVA; if the load exceeds rating, reduce it before suspecting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Rated kVA ke mutabiq load nikalein; agar load rating se ooper hai to inverter ka shak karna se pehle load kam karein.

solutions.en: If load and battery are both good, the inverter feedback divider or leg is faulty and needs board-level service.
solutions.ur: Agar load aur battery dono theek hon to inverter feedback divider ya leg kharab hai aur board level par service chahiye.

notes.en: Expect the load to restart or reset on its own after the source is cleared and the unit is power-cycled.
notes.ur: Wajah hatane aur unit power-cycle karne ke baad load apne aap restart ya reset ho jata hai.

title.en: Inverter A output (line to neutral) short circuited (0x14)

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected from inverter phase A output to neutral, so the unit has locked out.
meaning.ur: Inverter phase A output se neutral ke darmiyan short detect hua hai, is liye unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Load side short between phase A and neutral.
causes.ur: Load side par phase A aur neutral ke darmiyan short.

causes.en: Damaged output busbar, cable or outlet with a pinched conductor.
causes.ur: Output busbar, cable ya outlet damaged aur koi conductor nichal hua hai.

causes.en: Inverter phase A IGBT failed shorted, so the leg is effectively a short to the DC bus.
causes.ur: Inverter phase A ka IGBT short ho kar kharab, is liye leg practically DC bus ka short hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then disconnect all load before investigating.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir dekhne se pehle saara load nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Measure phase A to neutral continuity with a megger or multimeter; expect no continuity on a healthy installation.
solutions.ur: Megger ya multimeter se phase A se neutral ki continuity nikaalein; healthy installation par continuity nahi honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Walk the phase A conductors from the UPS output terminals to the furthest outlet, checking each section for damage or pinching.
solutions.ur: Phase A conductors ko UPS output terminals se sab se door outlet tak dekhein, har hissa damage ya pinching ke liye check karte hue.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one circuit at a time to isolate the shorted section; if the short persists with all load off, the IGBT has failed.
solutions.ur: Load aik-ik circuit karke dobara connect karte jayein taake short wala hissa pakda jaye; poora load off hone par bhi short rahe to IGBT kharab hai.

notes.en: Severity danger: a live output short will destroy the IGBT and can start a fire at the battery bus.
notes.ur: Severity danger: live output short IGBT kharab kar dega aur battery bus par aag laga sakta hai.

source.title: Easy UPS SRV/SRVL Modbus Register Map (Network Management Card)

title.en: Inverter B output (line to neutral) short circuited (0x15)

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected from inverter phase B output to neutral, so the unit has locked out.
meaning.ur: Inverter phase B output se neutral ke darmiyan short detect hua hai, is liye unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Load side short between phase B and neutral.
causes.ur: Load side par phase B aur neutral ke darmiyan short.

causes.en: Damaged or pinched phase B output wiring, busbar or outlet.
causes.ur: Phase B ki output wiring, busbar ya outlet damaged ya nichal hua hai.

causes.en: Inverter phase B IGBT failed shorted.
causes.ur: Inverter phase B ka IGBT short ho kar kharab.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then remove all load before measuring.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir measure karne se pehle saara load nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Measure phase B to neutral continuity with a megger and compare with phase A and C.
solutions.ur: Megger se phase B se neutral ki continuity nikaalein aur phase A aur C se compare karein.

solutions.en: Trace the phase B conductor section by section from the UPS output to the last outlet, checking for pinching and damaged insulation.
solutions.ur: Phase B conductor ko UPS output se aakhri outlet tak hissa hissa dekhein, pinching aur damaged insulation check karte hue.

solutions.en: Energise the load one circuit at a time to isolate the shorted branch; if it persists unloaded, replace the phase B module.
solutions.ur: Short wala branch dhoondne ke liye load aik aik circuit karke chalayein; load hata kar bhi rahe to phase B module badal dein.

notes.en: Phase B only exists on 3-phase SRV/SRVL units. Do not show this code on a 1-phase model.
notes.ur: Phase B sirf 3-phase SRV/SRVL units par hota hai. Ise 1-phase model par mat dikhayein.

source.title: Easy UPS SRV/SRVL Modbus Register Map (Network Management Card)

title.en: Inverter C output (line to neutral) short circuited (0x16)

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected from inverter phase C output to neutral, so the unit has locked out.
meaning.ur: Inverter phase C output se neutral ke darmiyan short detect hua hai, is liye unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Load side short between phase C and neutral.
causes.ur: Load side par phase C aur neutral ke darmiyan short.

causes.en: Damaged or pinched phase C output wiring, busbar or outlet.
causes.ur: Phase C ki output wiring, busbar ya outlet damaged ya nichal hua hai.

causes.en: Inverter phase C IGBT failed shorted.
causes.ur: Inverter phase C ka IGBT short ho kar kharab.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then remove all load before measuring.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir measure karne se pehle saara load nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Measure phase C to neutral continuity with a megger and compare with phases A and B.
solutions.ur: Megger se phase C se neutral ki continuity nikaalein aur phase A aur B se compare karein.

solutions.en: Trace the phase C conductor from the UPS output through each distribution board, checking for a pin or a crushed cable.
solutions.ur: Phase C conductor ko UPS output se har distribution board tak dekhein, pin ya crushed cable ke liye check karte hue.

solutions.en: If the short persists with all load disconnected, the phase C module has failed and needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar poora load disconnect hone par bhi short rahe to phase C module kharab ho gaya hai aur badalna hoga.

notes.en: Phase C only exists on 3-phase SRV/SRVL units. Do not show this code on a 1-phase model.
notes.ur: Phase C sirf 3-phase SRV/SRVL units par hota hai. Ise 1-phase model par mat dikhayein.

title.en: Inverter A-B output (line to line) short circuited (0x17)

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected between inverter phases A and B, so the unit has locked out.
meaning.ur: Inverter phases A aur B ke darmiyan short detect hua hai, is liye unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Load side phase-to-phase short between A and B, common when a three-phase motor or heater faults.
causes.ur: Load side par A aur B ke darmiyan phase-to-phase short - teen-phase motor ya heater kharab hone par aam masla hai.

causes.en: Phase-to-phase bridging in the output panel or a wrong neutral/phase connection in a distribution board.
causes.ur: Output panel par phase-to-phase shorting ya distribution board mein ghalat neutral/phase connection.

causes.en: Inverter IGBTs on phases A and B both failed shorted.
causes.ur: Phase A aur B dono ke inverter IGBTs short ho kar kharab.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then disconnect all three-phase load before measuring.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir measure karne se pehle saara three-phase load disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure A-B continuity with a megger; a healthy installation reads open.
solutions.ur: Megger se A-B continuity nikaalein; healthy installation par yeh khuli parhni chahiye.

solutions.en: Check each three-phase load separately for phase-to-phase continuity, starting with motors and heater elements.
solutions.ur: Har three-phase load ki alag phase-to-phase continuity check karein, motor aur heater elements se shuru karein.

solutions.en: Verify phase sequence and terminations in every distribution board; a swapped phase often presents as a short.
solutions.ur: Har distribution board mein phase sequence aur connections check karein; ulda hua phase aksar short ki shakal mein nazar aata hai.

notes.en: Phase-to-phase shorts are far more likely on 3-phase motors than line-to-neutral; test the motor first.
notes.ur: Phase-to-phase short line-to-neutral se kahin zyada sambhavit 3-phase motors par hote hain; pehle motor test karein.

meaning.ur: Inverter phases B aur C ke darmiyan short detect hua hai, is liye unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Load side phase-to-phase short between B and C.
causes.ur: Load side par B aur C ke darmiyan phase-to-phase short.

causes.en: Phase-to-phase bridging in the output panel or a wrong connection in a distribution board.
causes.ur: Output panel par phase-to-phase shorting ya distribution board mein ghalat connection.

causes.en: Inverter IGBTs on phases B and C both failed shorted.
causes.ur: Phase B aur C dono ke inverter IGBTs short ho kar kharab.

solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir measure karne se pehle saara three-phase load disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure B-C continuity with a megger and compare with A-B and A-C.
solutions.ur: Megger se B-C continuity nikaalein aur A-B aur A-C se compare karein.

solutions.en: Isolate each three-phase load in turn to find the shorted branch.
solutions.ur: Teen-phase load ko ek-ek karke alag karke short wala branch dhoondein.

solutions.en: Inspect the output panel busbar for a tool, a washer or a cable lug bridging B and C.
solutions.ur: Output panel ke busbar par koi tool, washer ya cable lug to B aur C ke darmiyan bridge kar raha hai ya nahi dekhein.

notes.ur: Phase C sirf 3-phase units par hota hai. Ise 1-phase model par mat dikhayein.

title.en: Inverter C-A output (line to line) short circuited (0x19)

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected between inverter phases C and A, so the unit has locked out.
meaning.ur: Inverter phases C aur A ke darmiyan short detect hua hai, is liye unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Load side phase-to-phase short between C and A.
causes.ur: Load side par C aur A ke darmiyan phase-to-phase short.

causes.en: Phase-to-phase bridging in the output panel or a miswired distribution board.
causes.ur: Output panel par phase-to-phase shorting ya ghalat wiring wala distribution board.

causes.en: Inverter IGBTs on phases C and A both failed shorted.
causes.ur: Phase C aur A dono ke inverter IGBTs short ho kar kharab.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then disconnect all three-phase load before measuring.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir measure karne se pehle saara three-phase load disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure C-A continuity with a megger; a healthy installation reads open.
solutions.ur: Megger se C-A continuity nikaalein; healthy installation par yeh khuli parhni chahiye.

solutions.en: Test each three-phase load separately and start with any that has been recently serviced or moved.
solutions.ur: Har three-phase load ko alag test karein aur shuru kisi aise se karein jise haal hi mein service ya hataya gaya ho.

solutions.en: Check the output panel for loose busbar hardware bridging C and A before condemning the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter kharab kehne se pehle output panel mein C aur A ko bridge karne wala loose busbar hardware dekhein.

notes.en: Phase C only exists on 3-phase units. Do not show this on a 1-phase model.

meaning.en: The inverter detected current flowing backwards on phase A, which normally means a miswired or regenerative load.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne phase A par ulta current detect kiya, jo aam tor par galat wiring ya regenerative load ka ishara hai.

causes.en: Phase A output and neutral wired in reverse, so current returns on the wrong conductor.
causes.ur: Phase A output aur neutral ulat wiring ke hain, is liye current ghalat conductor par wapas aata hai.

causes.en: A load that feeds power back into the UPS, such as a generator or another UPS in parallel without proper sharing.
causes.ur: Aisa load jo UPS mein power wapas daalta hai, jaise generator ya doosra UPS jo sahi tareeqe se share kiye baghair parallel hai.

causes.en: Current transformer on phase A miswired or failed, giving a false reverse reading.
causes.ur: Phase A ka current transformer galat wiring ya kharab, jis se ghalat reverse reading aati hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then verify phase A and neutral termination at the output terminal and in every distribution board.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir output terminal aur har distribution board mein phase A aur neutral ki wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Check that no generator or second UPS is hard-paralleled to this unit; use an interlock or separate transfer switch instead.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke koi generator ya doosra UPS is unit se seedha parallel na ho; uske bajaye interlock ya alag transfer switch istemaal karein.

solutions.en: Measure the phase A current with a clamp meter; a small reverse reading points to a sensing/CT problem, a large one to wiring.
solutions.ur: Phase A ka current clamp meter se nikaalein; chhota reverse reading sensing/CT ki masla batata hai, bara wiring ki.

solutions.en: Have the phase A current sensing circuit verified at board level if the clamp meter shows forward current.
solutions.ur: Agar clamp meter aage ka current dikhaye to phase A current sensing circuit board level par verify karwa lein.

notes.en: Do not attempt to run a hard-paralleled generator with this UPS; negative power destroys the inverter stage.
notes.ur: Is UPS ke saath seedha parallel generator chalane ki koshish na karein; negative power inverter stage kharab kar deta hai.

causes.en: A load feeding power back into the UPS without proper interlock.
causes.ur: Aisa load jo sahi interlock ke baghair UPS mein power wapas daalta hai.

causes.en: Phase B current sensing circuit miswired or failed.
causes.ur: Phase B ka current sensing circuit galat wiring ya kharab.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then verify phase B and neutral termination at the output and in every distribution board.

solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke koi generator ya doosra UPS is unit se seedha parallel na ho; interlock istemaal karein.

solutions.en: Measure phase B current with a clamp meter to separate a wiring fault from a sensing fault.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se phase B ka current nikaal kar wiring fault aur sensing fault ko alag karein.

solutions.en: Have the phase B current sensing circuit verified at board level if the meter shows forward current.
solutions.ur: Agar meter aage ka current dikhaye to phase B current sensing circuit board level par verify karwa lein.

meaning.en: The SCR that controls battery charging has failed, so the battery string is not being charged.
meaning.ur: Battery charging control karne wala SCR kharab ho gaya hai, is liye battery string charge nahi ho rahi.

causes.en: Charging SCR failed shorted, over-loading and heating the rectifier stage.
causes.ur: Charging SCR short ho kar kharab, rectifier stage par bohat load dal kar usay garam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Charging SCR failed open, so no charge current reaches the battery at all.
causes.ur: Charging SCR khul ho kar kharab, is liye battery tak koi charge current hi nahi pohanchta.

causes.en: SCR gate drive circuit failed so the SCR is never commanded on.
causes.ur: SCR gate drive circuit kharab, is liye SCR ko kabhi on command nahi milta.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then measure charger output DC voltage at the battery terminals with the battery reconnected.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir battery dobara connect kar ke battery terminals par charger output DC voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Confirm zero or no charge voltage first, so you do not chase a battery that is merely full.
solutions.ur: Pehle confirm karein ke charge voltage zero ya nahi hai, taake aise battery ko na pakdein jo sirf poori tarah charge ho.

solutions.en: Check the SCR gate drive output and its snubber components on the charger board for a failed device.
solutions.ur: Charger board par SCR gate drive output aur uske snubber components check kar ke kharab device dhoondein.

solutions.en: Have the SCR replaced at component level with the correct part number, and check for a shorted battery before recharging.
solutions.ur: SCR ko sahi part number se component level par badalwa lein, aur recharge se pehle battery ka short check karein.

notes.en: An SCR failed shorted also explains 0x06 (Converter over current) - check both together.
notes.ur: SCR short hone par 0x06 (Converter over current) bhi samajhata hai - dono saath check karein.

meaning.en: The relay that connects the inverter to the output bus has welded, so the inverter can no longer be isolated.
meaning.ur: Woh relay jo inverter ko output bus se jorta hai jalm (weld) gaya hai, is liye inverter ab alag nahi kiya ja sakta.

causes.en: Inverter relay contacts welded from an arc during a short-circuit event.
causes.ur: Short-circuit event ke dauran arc se inverter relay ke contacts jalm gaye hain.

causes.en: Relay contact faces pitted from long service life and inrush current.
causes.ur: Lamba service life aur inrush current se relay ke contact faces ghis chuke hain.

causes.en: Relay coil or mechanism failed so the relay cannot break contact at all.
causes.ur: Relay coil ya mechanism kharab ho gaya hai jis se relay bilkul contact nahi chhod pata.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then confirm the inverter relay position with the unit unpowered.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir unpowered state mein inverter relay ki position confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure relay coil continuity/resistance across its pins after lifting the relay from circuit.
solutions.ur: Relay circuit se uthane ke baad uske pins par coil continuity/resistance nikaalein.

solutions.en: Inspect the contact surfaces for welding pitting or discoloration; a welded or pitted relay cannot be cleaned back into spec.
solutions.ur: Contact surfaces par welding pitting ya rang badla dekhein; jalmaya ya gis chuka relay theek nahi ho sakta.

solutions.en: Replace the relay with the specified part number, and add a surge protection device upstream so arc events are absorbed.
solutions.ur: Relay ko bataye gaye part number se badal dein, aur upstream surge protection device lagayein taake arc events absorb hon.

notes.en: A welded inverter relay means the unit cannot be serviced safely in bypass - it needs the relay replaced, not a reset.
notes.ur: Jalmaya inverter relay matlab unit ko bypass mein mehfooz tareeqe se service nahi kiya ja sakta - reset nahi, relay badalna hoga.

meaning.en: Battery pack voltage has risen above the safe ceiling, so the charger has shut down to protect the cells.
meaning.ur: Battery pack voltage safe ceiling se upar chala gaya hai, is liye charger ne cells bachane ke liye band kar diya.

causes.en: Charger output failed high, or the wrong charge voltage is configured for the pack.
causes.ur: Charger output high par kharab, ya pack ke liye ghalat charge voltage set hai.

causes.en: Wrong battery type fitted - a pack rated for a lower charge voltage is being over-charged.
causes.ur: Ghalat battery type lagi hai - kam charge voltage rated pack ko zyada charge kiya ja raha hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature very high with no charge-voltage temperature compensation configured.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai aur charge voltage ka temperature compensation set nahi.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure each cell's voltage; a swollen, hot or leaking cell means replace the pack, do not recharge.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir har cell ka voltage nikaalein; phooli, garam ya leaking cell matlab pack badal dein, recharge na karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the installed battery type and charge voltage against the manual's battery configuration section.
solutions.ur: Manual ke battery configuration section ke mutabiq lagi hui battery type aur charge voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure charger output voltage at the battery terminals with the battery connected; out-of-spec output means the charger board is faulty.
solutions.ur: Battery connect kar ke battery terminals par charger output voltage nikaalein; output spec se bahar ho to charger board kharab hai.

solutions.en: Enable or verify charge-voltage temperature compensation so hot cabinets do not over-charge the pack.
solutions.ur: Charge voltage ka temperature compensation on karein ya verify karein taake garam cabinet pack ko over-charge na kare.

notes.en: SE's Easy UPS 3S equivalent alarm is 'Over charge' with the corrective action 'Contact your dealer.'
notes.ur: SE ke Easy UPS 3S mein iska barabar alarm 'Over charge' hai aur hal likha hai 'Contact your dealer.'

source.title: Easy UPS SRV/SRVL Modbus Register Map (Network Management Card)

meaning.en: Battery pack voltage has dropped below the minimum, so the UPS is about to or already in shutdown.
meaning.ur: Battery pack voltage minimum se neeche gir gaya hai, is liye UPS band hone wali hai ya band ho chuki hai.

causes.en: Battery string exhausted by a long outage and not recharged.
causes.ur: Battery string lambi outage se khatam ho gayi aur recharge nahi hui.

causes.en: Battery cells aged and no longer able to hold charge.
causes.ur: Battery cells purani ho chuki hain aur charge rok nahi saktin.

causes.en: Charger not working so the pack never recovers between outages.
causes.ur: Charger kaam nahi kar raha, is liye pack outages ke darmiyan recover hi nahi hota.

causes.en: One or more cells shorted, dragging the string voltage down.
causes.ur: Aik ya zyada cells short ho kar string voltage neeche kheench rahe hain.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, and measure the string and each cell with a DC meter.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein, battery disconnect karein, phir string aur har cell ko DC meter se nikaalein.

solutions.en: If the pack is merely discharged, charge on mains for at least 4 hours and re-read the register before condemning it.
solutions.ur: Agar pack sirf discharge hui hai to mains par kam az kam 4 ghante charge karein aur kharab kehne se pehle register dobara parhein.

solutions.en: If it still reads low, replace the pack with the specified type and number; a low pack cannot be recovered.
solutions.ur: Agar phir bhi kam parhe to pack ko bataye gaye type aur number se badal dein; kam pack recover nahi ho sakta.

solutions.en: Verify the charger is actually delivering current (see 0x2A and 0x21) or the new pack will fail the same way.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke charger waqai current de raha hai (0x2A aur 0x21 dekhein) warna naya pack bhi waise hi fail hoga.

notes.en: This is a battery-safety state: the UPS will drop the load rather than deep-discharge the pack further.
notes.ur: Yeh battery safety ki halat hai: UPS pack ko aur discharge hone se bachane ke liye load phenk dega.

title.en: Battery fuse broken in Battery mode (0x29)
title.ur: Battery fuse broken in battery mode (0x29)

meaning.en: The battery string fuse has opened only when running on battery, so the inverter loses its DC source on discharge.
meaning.ur: Battery string ka fuse sirf battery par chalte waqt khul gaya hai, is liye inverter ko discharge par DC source chala jata hai.

causes.en: Battery string fuse has failed at the rated current, or is the wrong rating for the pack.
causes.ur: Battery string ka fuse rated current par fail ho gaya, ya pack ke liye ghalat rating ka hai.

causes.en: A shorted cell in the pack made the fuse blow, but the cause was never fixed.
causes.ur: Pack mein shorted cell ne fuse uda diya magar wajah kabhi theek nahi hui.

causes.en: Fuse holder contact resistance high, so the fuse runs hot and opens under load.
causes.ur: Fuse holder ka contact resistance zyada hai, is liye fuse garam hokar load par khul jata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then check the string fuse continuity with an ohmmeter.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir ohmmeter se string fuse ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Do not simply fit a bigger fuse; measure the pack's actual current draw and fit the fuse rating the manual specifies.
solutions.ur: Bada fuse andaza kar na lagayein; pack ka asli current draw nikaal kar manual ki batay hui rating ka fuse lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure each cell's voltage and internal resistance to find and replace a shorted cell before fitting any new fuse.
solutions.ur: Naya fuse lagane se pehle har cell ka voltage aur internal resistance nikaal kar shorted cell dhoondhein aur badal dein.

solutions.en: Inspect and clean the fuse holder contacts and check the holder's bolt torque; loose holders run hot.
solutions.ur: Fuse holder ke contacts saaf karein aur holder ka bolt torque check karein; loose holders garam hote hain.

notes.en: 'In Battery mode' is the clue: on mains the fuse may hold, which is why this fault is often mistaken for a dead battery.
notes.ur: 'In battery mode' hi asli clue hai: mains par fuse chal sakta hai, is liye yeh fault aksar kharab battery samajh liya jata hai.

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected on the charger's output path to the battery, so the charger has shut down.
meaning.ur: Charger ke battery output path par short detect hua hai, is liye charger band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Shorted battery cell or a reversed-connected external battery cabinet.
causes.ur: Shorted battery cell ya ulat polarity se laga external battery cabinet.

causes.en: Charging SCR failed shorted, shorting the charge output internally.
causes.ur: Charging SCR short ho kar kharab, andar se charge output short kar raha hai.

causes.en: Charger output capacitor shorted, or a cable pinched against the battery tray.
causes.ur: Charger output capacitor short ho gaya, ya battery tray ke khilaf cable nichal hui hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then measure resistance across the charger output terminals; near-zero means the short is real.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir charger output terminals par resistance nikaalein; zero ke qareeb matlab short asal hai.

solutions.en: Measure each battery cell's resistance individually to locate a shorted cell, and check the external cabinet's polarity.
solutions.ur: Har battery cell ka resistance alag alag nikaal kar shorted cell dhoondein, aur external cabinet ki polarity check karein.

solutions.en: Do a braindead-style isolation: disconnect the battery and external cabinets, then re-measure to see if the short persists inside the charger.
solutions.ur: Braindead jaisa isolation karein: battery aur external cabinets disconnect kar ke dobara measure karein ke short charger ke andar bacha hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the short persists with the battery removed, the charging SCR or output capacitor is failed and must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Agar battery nikalne par bhi short rahe to charging SCR ya output capacitor kharab hai aur badalna hoga.

notes.en: SE's Easy UPS 3S equivalent alarm is 'Battery/charger inoperable - Check the battery. Check the charger.'
notes.ur: SE ke Easy UPS 3S mein iska barabar alarm 'Battery/charger inoperable' hai - 'Battery check karein, charger check karein.'

meaning.en: Units in a parallel system cannot talk over the parallel bus, so they cannot share load or synchronise.
meaning.ur: Parallel system mein units parallel bus par baat nahi kar pa rahi, is liye load share ya synchronise nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Parallel communication cable unplugged, reversed between units, or damaged.
causes.ur: Parallel communication cable nikal hua, units ke darmiyan ulat, ya damaged hai.

causes.en: Parallel bus terminated incorrectly so the chain has no end termination.
causes.ur: Parallel bus ki termination ghalat hai jis se chain ka end termination nahi banta.

causes.en: Parallel port or interface on one unit failed, leaving it deaf on the bus.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit ka parallel port ya interface kharab hai jis se woh bus par sun nahi sakta.

causes.en: Module ID duplicated in a parallel system, so two units claim the same address.
causes.ur: Parallel system mein module ID duplicate hai jis se do units aik hi address claim kar lete hain.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate all units, then reseat the parallel cable at every unit, checking it is not reversed.
solutions.ur: Sab units power off aur isolate karein, phir parallel cable har unit par dobara baitha dein aur check karein ke ulat nahi.

solutions.en: Verify each unit has a unique module ID; a duplicate ID is a common cause and is easy to overlook.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke har unit ka module ID unique hai; duplicate ID aam wajah hai aur nazar se chhoot jata hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the parallel chain end termination is fitted exactly as the installation manual requires.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke parallel chain ka end termination installation manual ke mutabiq lagaya gaya hai.

solutions.en: Swap the parallel cable with a known-good one to rule out the cable, then test the suspect unit on its own.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable ko aik ache se chalne wale cable se badal dein taake cable hat jaye, phir shak ke unit ko akela test karein.

notes.en: SE's Easy UPS 3S equivalent alarms are 'Parallel cabling incorrect' and 'Module ID duplicate'.
notes.ur: SE ke Easy UPS 3S mein iske barabar alarms hain 'Parallel cabling incorrect' aur 'Module ID duplicate'.

meaning.en: Units in a parallel system are not sharing current equally, so one unit is carrying more than it should.
meaning.ur: Parallel system mein units current barabar share nahi kar rahe, is liye aik unit par apni se zyada load hai.

causes.en: Load not evenly distributed between the paralleled units.
causes.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan load barabar baanta hua nahi hai.

causes.en: One unit's inverter stage degraded, so it cannot deliver its share.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit ka inverter stage weak ho gaya hai jis se woh apna hissa nahi de sakta.

causes.en: Output current sensing on one unit drifted or miscalibrated.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit ka output current sensing drift ya miscalibrate ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Parallel cable or interlock fault letting units fight each other on the output.
causes.ur: Parallel cable ya interlock fault jis se units output par aik doosre se lad rahi hain.

solutions.en: Measure the output current of each paralleled unit individually with a clamp meter and record the readings.
solutions.ur: Har paralleled unit ka output current alag alag clamp meter se nikaal kar readings note karein.

solutions.en: Calculate the imbalance as (highest - lowest) / average; a spread beyond the manual's limit points to a real fault.
solutions.ur: Imbalance aise nikalein: (sab se oopper - sab se neeche) / average; manual ki limit se zyada farq asal fault hai.

solutions.en: Redistribute the load between units so each carries a similar share, then re-read the register.
solutions.ur: Units ke darmiyan load aise baant dein ke har aik barabar hissa uthaye, phir register dobara parhein.

solutions.en: If the imbalance persists with even load, have the suspect unit's inverter and current sensing verified on its own, outside the parallel set.
solutions.ur: Agar barabar load par bhi farq rahe to shak ke unit ke inverter aur current sensing ko parallel set se bahar akela verify karwa lein.

notes.en: SE's Easy UPS 3S equivalent alarm is 'Power sharing incorrect - Redistribute the load between UPS units.'
notes.ur: SE ke Easy UPS 3S mein iska barabar alarm 'Power sharing incorrect' hai - 'Load UPS units ke darmiyan dobara baant dein.'

meaning.en: The UPS internal temperature has exceeded its limit, so the unit has shut down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: UPS ki andar ki temperature limit se upar chala gayi hai, is liye unit apni protection ke liye band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Cooling fans failed, so no air is being moved through the unit.
causes.ur: Cooling fans kharab ho gaye, is liye unit mein se hawa nahi chal rahi.

causes.en: Intake or exhaust grille blocked by dust, restricting airflow.
causes.ur: Intake ya exhaust grille dhool se band, is liye airflow restricted hai.

causes.en: Ambient room temperature above the rated limit, typical of an unconditioned equipment room.
causes.ur: Room ki ambient temperature rated limit se upar hai - bina air conditioning ke equipment room mein aam masla hai.

causes.en: Internal heatsink fouled with dust, or a component running hotter than design.
causes.ur: Andar ka heatsink dhool se bhar gaya, ya koi component design se zyada garam chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then measure the internal temperature with a probe and compare to the unit's limit.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir probe se andar ki temperature nikaal kar unit ki limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Clean every fan, heatsink and grille with compressed air and confirm each fan spins on power-up.
solutions.ur: Har fan, heatsink aur grille ko compressed air se saaf karein aur confirm karein ke har fan power par chalta hai.

solutions.en: Measure room temperature and improve cooling: add an air conditioner or a dedicated exhaust fan for the equipment room.
solutions.ur: Room temperature nikaalein aur cooling behtar karein: equipment room ke liye air conditioner ya alag exhaust fan lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the fan supply and fan controller on the board; a fan that does not spin at all is a wiring or board fault, not dirt.
solutions.ur: Board par fan supply aur fan controller check karein; jo fan bilkul na chale woh wiring ya board fault hai, dhool nahi.

notes.en: SE's Easy UPS 3S equivalents are 'Bypass fan inoperable', 'Fan inoperable', 'Inlet temperature high' and 'Outlet temperature high'.
notes.ur: SE ke Easy UPS 3S mein iske barabar hain 'Bypass fan inoperable', 'Fan inoperable', 'Inlet temperature high' aur 'Outlet temperature high'.

title.ur: CPU communication fault (0x42) - CPU ki baat band

meaning.en: The main processor cannot exchange data with the DSP that controls the power stage, so the unit has shut down.
meaning.ur: Main processor DSP se data exchange nahi kar sakta jo power stage control karta hai, is liye unit band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: CAN bus wiring or connector between CPU board and DSP board loose or chafed.
causes.ur: CPU board aur DSP board ke darmiyan CAN bus wiring ya connector loose ya ragis hua hai.

causes.en: One of the two boards failed, holding the bus low so neither can talk.
causes.ur: Do boards mein se koi aik kharab ho kar bus ko low par rok kar baitha hai.

causes.en: A mains surge destroyed one of the communication transceivers.
causes.ur: Mains surge ne communication transceivers mein se koi aik tabah kar diya.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, and use an anti-static strap before touching board connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein, battery disconnect karein, aur board connector chhoone se pehle anti-static strap lagayein.

solutions.en: Reseat every CPU-to-DSP harness and connector, then inspect the cables for cuts along their routing.
solutions.ur: Har CPU-to-DSP harness aur connector dobara baitha dein, phir cables ko unke raaste mein tute hisse dekhne ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: With boards powered and safe to probe, check the CAN bus for a stuck-low line and trace it to the board holding it.
solutions.ur: Boards power par hone aur probe karne ke laiq ho to CAN bus par atki hui line dhoondein aur us board tak pohonchein.

solutions.en: Replace the failed CPU or DSP board; the bus itself rarely fails on its own.
solutions.ur: Kharab CPU ya DSP board badal dein; bus khud kam hote hain kharab hota hai.

notes.en: SE's Easy UPS SRV 6kVA/10kVA manual lists 'CPU communication failure detected' and 'CAN communication alert' as separate named internal faults.
notes.ur: SE ke Easy UPS SRV 6kVA/10kVA manual mein 'CPU communication failure detected' aur 'CAN communication alert' alag alag named internal faults hain.

meaning.en: The connected load exceeds what the UPS can supply, so the unit has shut down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Lagi hui load UPS ki capacity se zyada hai, is liye unit apni protection ke liye band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment connected, or load added after installation.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada equipment lagi hai, ya installation ke baad load barha diya gaya.

causes.en: One load shorted or failed, drawing far more current than its rating.
causes.ur: Koi aik load short ya kharab ho kar apni rating se bohat zyada current kheech raha hai.

causes.en: A motor or compressor with a locked rotor drawing several times its running current.
causes.ur: Motor ya compressor ka rotor jam ho kar apne chalne wale current se kai guna current kheech raha hai.

causes.en: Load current sensing drifted, so the unit believes a normal load is an overload.
causes.ur: Load current sensing drift ho gayi hai, is liye unit normal load ko overload samajhta hai.

solutions.en: Read the load percentage from the unit or the register and compare it with the unit's rated kVA.
solutions.ur: Unit ya register se load percentage parhein aur unit ki rated kVA se compare karein.

solutions.en: Remove load one circuit at a time, and the priority is to find any shorted or seized motor or compressor first.
solutions.ur: Load aik aik circuit karke nikaalein, aur pehle short ya jam hua motor ya compressor dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Measure each load's current with a clamp meter on the output; a single circuit far above its nameplate is the culprit.
solutions.ur: Output par clamp meter se har load ka current nikaalein; nameplate se bohat oopper aik circuit hi asal culprit hai.

solutions.en: If the calculated load is well within rating, check the load current sensor and its wiring for drift or damage.
solutions.ur: Agar hisaab wala load rating ke andar hai to load current sensor aur uski wiring drift ya damage ke liye check karein.

notes.en: Overload is the most common fault on Pakistani sites after a load-shedding power cut when everything switches back at once.
notes.ur: Load-shedding ke baad sab kuch aik saath on hone par overload Pakistani sites par sab se aam fault hai.

meaning.en: The control board does not recognise the model's rating data, so it cannot configure the power stage correctly.
meaning.ur: Control board model ki rating data ko pehchan nahi raha, is liye power stage ko theek se configure nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Control board from a different model fitted, so its model data does not match the hardware.
causes.ur: Doosre model ka control board lagaya gaya hai jis ka model data hardware se match nahi karta.

causes.en: Model/rating configuration memory lost after an EEPROM or factory-reset event.
causes.ur: EEPROM ya factory-reset event ke baad model/rating configuration memory kho gaya.

causes.en: Firmware version does not match the hardware revision of the unit.
causes.ur: Firmware version unit ke hardware revision se match nahi karta.

solutions.en: Check the board part number and the model/rating label on the chassis; they must correspond to the same model.
solutions.ur: Board ka part number aur chassis par model/rating label dekhein; dono aik hi model ke hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Run the model/rating configuration or factory setup from the manual so the controller is told what hardware it has.
solutions.ur: Manual ka model/rating configuration ya factory setup chalayein taake controller ko hardware ka pata chale.

solutions.en: After configuration, power-cycle and re-read register 44497 to confirm 0x46 has cleared.
solutions.ur: Configuration ke baad power-cycle kar ke register 44497 dobara parhein taake confirm ho ke 0x46 mit gaya.

solutions.en: If no configuration makes it clear, the control board carries the wrong model data and must be replaced or reflashed.
solutions.ur: Agar koi configuration clear na kare to control board par ghalat model data hai aur board badalna ya dobara flash karna hoga.

notes.en: This code points at parts-swap errors, so check the board identity before any other troubleshooting.
notes.ur: Yeh code parts badalne ki ghalti par ishara karta hai, is liye baqi troubleshooting se pehle board ki pehchan check karein.

meaning.en: The microcontroller has lost communication with the processor, so the unit cannot run its control sequence.
meaning.ur: Microcontroller ne processor se communication kho diya hai, is liye unit apna control sequence nahi chala sakta.

causes.en: MCU-to-processor bus wiring or connector loose, chafed or corroded.
causes.ur: MCU se processor ki bus wiring ya connector loose, ragis ya zange se kharab.

causes.en: MCU or processor board failed after a surge or heat damage.
causes.ur: Surge ya garmi ke baad MCU ya processor board kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: MCU clock or supply rail unstable, so the link drops intermittently.
causes.ur: MCU ka clock ya supply rail unstable hai jis se link baar baar toot raha hai.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, and use an anti-static strap before touching the boards.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein, battery disconnect karein, aur boards chhoone se pehle anti-static strap lagayein.

solutions.en: Reseat every MCU-to-processor connector and clean the pin contacts; check for a corroded pin.
solutions.ur: Har MCU-to-processor connector dobara baitha dein aur pin contacts saaf karein; zange wale pin ko check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the MCU supply rail and clock with a meter or scope at the MCU to confirm they are stable.
solutions.ur: MCU par meter ya scope se MCU ki supply rail aur clock nikaal kar confirm karein ke woh stable hain.

solutions.en: If the rails and clock are good, swap the MCU board with a known-good one to confirm the fault before replacing.
solutions.ur: Agar rails aur clock theek hon to MCU board ko aik ache wale se badal kar fault confirm karein, phir tabdeeli karein.

notes.en: Keep MCU (0x47) and CPU (0x42) faults distinct - they are different chips on different buses.
notes.ur: MCU (0x47) aur CPU (0x42) ke faults alag rakhein - yeh alag chips hain aur alag buses par hain.

title.en: Two DSP firmware versions are incompatible (0x48)
title.ur: Do DSP firmware versions incompatible hain (0x48)

meaning.en: The two DSPs in the unit are running firmware that cannot work together, so the unit refuses to start.
meaning.ur: Unit ke do DSP aisa firmware chala rahe hain jo aapas mein kaam nahi kar sakta, is liye unit start nahi hota.

causes.en: A firmware update completed on only one DSP, leaving the pair mismatched.
causes.ur: Firmware update sirf aik DSP par mukammal hua, jis se jora mismatch ho gaya.

causes.en: DSP board replaced with one carrying different firmware from the original.
causes.ur: DSP board badla gaya jis par original se alag firmware hai.

causes.en: Update interrupted by power loss part-way through writing the second DSP.
causes.ur: Doosre DSP ko likhte waqt bijli chali gayi aur update adhoora reh gaya.

solutions.en: Do not interrupt a firmware write; run the full upgrade on stable mains with the battery fully charged so both DSPs are written.
solutions.ur: Firmware likhte waqt bijli na kaatein; poori battery charge par stable mains se poora upgrade chalayein taake dono DSP likh lein.

solutions.en: Compare the two DSP firmware versions in the service menu; they must be the same build.
solutions.ur: Service menu mein dono DSP ke firmware versions compare karein; woh aik hi build ke hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Re-run the official dual-DSP firmware upgrade package from Schneider Electric rather than flashing one DSP manually.
solutions.ur: Aik DSP ko manual flash karne ke bajaye Schneider Electric ka official dual-DSP firmware upgrade package dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: If one DSP board was replaced, flash it to the same version as the original before returning the unit to service.
solutions.ur: Agar aik DSP board badla gaya hai to unit wapas service mein dene se pehle use original ke barabar version par flash karein.

notes.en: Flashing a single DSP by hand is the usual cause of this code - always use the vendor's paired package.
notes.ur: Aik DSP ko haath se flash karna hi is code ki aam wajah hai - hamesha vendor ka jora package istemaal karein.

title.en: Input and output phases are incompatible (0x49)
title.ur: Input aur output phases incompatible hain (0x49)

meaning.en: The input and output phase rotations differ, so inverting from input to output is unsafe and the unit will not start.
meaning.ur: Input aur output ki phase rotation alag hai, is liye input se output mein invert karna unsafe hai aur unit start nahi karega.

causes.en: Input and output supply sequences genuinely different, e.g. R-Y-B versus B-Y-R.
causes.ur: Input aur output supply ki sequence asal mein alag hai, maslan R-Y-B versus B-Y-R.

causes.en: Input or output cables to two or three phases swapped at the terminal or in a distribution board.
causes.ur: Terminal ya distribution board mein do ya teen phases ke input ya output cables swap ho gaye hain.

causes.en: Parallel units with mismatched phase rotation commissioned together.
causes.ur: Phase rotation mismatch karne wale parallel units aik saath commission kiye gaye.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then measure the phase rotation of the input and the output with a phase rotation meter.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir phase rotation meter se input aur output ki phase rotation nikaalein.

solutions.en: Correct the sequence at the terminal or distribution board until the output matches the required rotation.
solutions.ur: Terminal ya distribution board par sequence theek karein jab tak output ki required rotation na mil jaye.

solutions.en: Confirm each individual phase-to-neutral and phase-to-phase output voltage with a meter, not just the sequence.
solutions.ur: Meter se sirf sequence nahi, har phase-to-neutral aur phase-to-phase output voltage bhi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Re-commission the unit and re-read register 44497 to confirm 0x49 has cleared before reconnecting the load.
solutions.ur: Unit dobara commission karein aur load dobara jorrne se pehle register 44497 parh kar confirm karein ke 0x49 mit gaya.

notes.en: Connecting a single-phase or two-phase load to a three-phase unit is a related site error worth checking at the same time.
notes.ur: Teen-phase unit par single-phase ya two-phase load jorrna aik isi tarah ki site ghalti hai jise saath check karein.
